title: ciso_exec_summary_render
description: Render-request contract of the ciso-executive-summary pack (Strategic Risk Intelligence Dashboard). The agent finishes the single-file HTML dashboard itself; this payload hands it to functions/delivery/renderers-src/ciso-exec-summary/render.py, which produces the A3 landscape PDF, the section PNGs and the governance PPTX from it. Named by that renderer's manifest.json. While the ciso-exec-summary pipeline delivers format 'html' with an empty renderTemplate, the HTML is gated by gates.ciso_exec_summary_html instead; this contract applies once the renderer is staged (registry: renderer_pending).

html.description: The complete single-file dashboard: no external references except the cdnjs Chart.js build allowed by templates/enx-theme.json charts.cdn, no unfilled {{PLACEHOLDER}}, ends with </html>. gates.ciso_exec_summary_html re-checks all of this.

vendor.description: Supplier name; substituted into the PPTX generator's VENDOR constant at run time (the staged script is never edited).

assessment.description: OneTrust assessment name/id; substituted into the ASSESSMENT constant.

baseName.description: Optional file-name stem (alphanumeric only). Defaults to the vendor name stripped of non-alphanumerics; produces <base>_CISO_ExecSummary.html/.pdf and <base>_CISO_TPRM_Governance.pptx.
